_meta.description: Mi Speaks is free to read with no time limit. Premium, an in-app purchase, is $4.99 a month, $39.99 a year or $99.99 once, with a 7-day free trial.

in-the-settings-app.8acee3: In the Settings app, tap your name, then Subscriptions, then Mi Speaks. Premium stays on until the end of the period you've paid for, and everything free keeps working after that.
library-sync-across-iphone.50100b: Library sync across iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
live-word-highlighting-pdf.8ec89f: Live word highlighting, PDF page view and chapters
monthly-and-yearly-both.354819: Monthly and Yearly both start with a 7-day free trial. You aren't charged until it ends, and cancelling before then costs nothing. Apple allows one trial per Apple Account.
open-premium-in-mi.c5ef79: Open Premium in Mi Speaks and tap Restore Purchases while signed in with the same Apple Account.
pay-once-and-keep.3aea67: Pay once and keep Premium for good. No subscription.
premium-adds-the-twenty.32e758: Premium adds the twenty-eight Studio Voices, an unlimited library synced across your devices, audio export, and Turbo playback speeds. $4.99 a month, $39.99 a year, or $99.99 once and kept.
reading-aloud-is-free.d7b375: Reading aloud is free, with no time limit. Premium is an optional in-app purchase: monthly, yearly, or once for good.
starts-with-a-7.9eca0d: Starts with a 7-day free trial. A third less than paying monthly.
studio-voice-audio-on.3ae651: Studio Voice audio on Apple Watch
there-is-no-length.989103: There is no length limit on the free tier. Paste a whole article, import a whole book, and listen to all of it with any voice on your device — no trial countdown, no truncation, no paywall in the middle of a chapter. Free keeps three saved speeches, each with its own place marked.

yes-monthly-yearly-and.03e883: Yes. Monthly, Yearly and Lifetime all work with Family Sharing, so everyone in your family group gets Premium.
